description: Authoritative project.json schema for NovaModuleTools projects.

$schema.description: Optional URI pointing to the versioned JSON schema for this file. Injected automatically by nova init.

ProjectName.description: Name of the module and the output folder under dist/.

Description.description: Human-readable project description. Feeds manifest and package metadata.

Version.description: Current semantic version of the project.

CopyResourcesToModuleRoot.description: When true, resources are copied into the module root instead of a resources/ subfolder.

BuildRecursiveFolders.description: Default enabled recursive discovery for src/classes, src/private and tests. src/public stays top-level only unless explicitly set to false for top-level-only discovery.

SetSourcePath.description: Default enabled source markers: emit '# Source: <relative path>' before each concatenated source file in the generated dist/<Project>/<Project>.psm1.

FailOnDuplicateFunctionNames.description: Default enabled validation: fail build when duplicate top-level function names exist in the generated dist/<Project>/<Project>.psm1.

Preamble.description: Optional module-level lines written at the very top of the generated dist/<Project>/<Project>.psm1 before any source markers or other generated content.

Manifest.description: Controls metadata for the generated PowerShell module manifest.

Author.description: Sets the manifest author and the default package author when Package.Authors is omitted.

PowerShellHostVersion.description: Defines the minimum PowerShell version expected by the generated module.

GUID.description: Sets the manifest GUID. Generate a new GUID for each distinct module.

Tags.description: Adds manifest tags and is reused by package metadata when present.

ProjectUri.description: Publishes a project URL in the manifest and package metadata.

ReleaseNotes.description: Publishes a release notes link for packaging and user-facing metadata.

LicenseUri.description: Publishes a license URL for packaging and manifest metadata.

IconUri.description: Publishes an icon URL for the module manifest.

Copyright.description: Sets the copyright string in the module manifest.

RequiredModules.description: Lists modules that must be imported before this module. Each entry is either a module name string or a module-specification object.

Package.description: Controls package creation and optional raw HTTP upload defaults.

Id.description: Package identifier used in generated package file names.

Types.description: List of package types to produce.

items.description: Valid values: NuGet, Zip, .nupkg, .zip (case-insensitive at runtime).

Latest.description: Controls whether a latest alias is published alongside the versioned package.

OutputDirectory.description: Directory where generated packages are written.

PackageFileName.description: Base file name for the generated package (without extension).

AddVersionToFileName.description: When true, the version string is appended to the package file name.

FileNamePattern.description: Glob pattern used to identify generated package files for upload.

Authors.description: Package authors list. Defaults to Manifest.Author when omitted.

Description.description: Package description. Defaults to top-level Description when omitted.

RepositoryUrl.description: Base URL for raw HTTP upload.

UploadPath.description: Sub-path appended to RepositoryUrl for the upload target.

Headers.description: Custom HTTP headers sent with every upload request.

Repositories.description: List of named upload repository targets.

Pester.description: Controls the Pester test run configuration used by Test-NovaBuild.

CodeCoverage.description: Configures code coverage collection during test runs.

Enabled.description: When true, code coverage is collected.

Path.description: Glob patterns selecting source files to include in coverage analysis.

CoveragePercentTarget.description: Minimum code coverage percentage required for a passing build.

OutputPath.description: Path where the coverage report file is written.

Enabled.description: When true, a test result file is written.

Output.description: Configures Pester console output during test runs.

Verbosity.description: Pester output verbosity level (e.g. Detailed, Normal, Minimal).
